checkpoints.description: [1/2] Pre-register and implement the HO-3 double-radial-shell probe in Rust with failing-first tests and independent audit rows

impact_assessment.benefits: Tests multi-node generality rather than another single-node identity, exercises a two-winding radial phase and local per-node FD convergence, and keeps the unified-field program tied to falsifiable structure.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Derive nodes from L_2^1 exactly; use full-domain phase gates plus separate node-centred local grids for each singular/FD probe; freeze eps0=0.1a0, 2pi deficit bound, analytic Q/norm formulas and 5% convergence gates in ADR-059 before seeing results; independently re-derive every gate in audit.rs and verify in two processes.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new multi-shell checks/audit rows and report family change fingerprints; dependency: stdlib only; concurrency: none; state: source, tests, reports, ledger and docs; physics: a global uniform grid cannot contain both irrational nodes, and a wrong product-phase or radial-Laplacian treatment could fake convergence.
impact_assessment.why: Claim 62 verifies only one simple radial zero. The hydrogen-3s state has two irrational radial nodes and is the next falsifiable test of whether the same single-valued complex-shift construction preserves regular phase, finite velocity/Q and the singular control at every node.

impact_assessment.benefits: Turns a central negative result into reproducible exact-integer evidence, exposes any search bug or hidden hit, and gives the unified-field program a concrete model-selection constraint.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Use exact integer cross-multiplication against rational targets; enumerate Dynkin labels 0..4 with sum<=k for N=2..7 and k=1..79; validate known SU(2)/SU(3) labels and model/label counts; independently re-derive the search in audit.rs; run tests, timing and two-process verification before delivery.

impact_assessment.why: The latest unification bottleneck is the claim that no single SU(N)_k model hosts all three sector phases, but single_model_exists() is currently a hardcoded false and the tests only assert that constant.

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Implement the all-positive-level inverse SU(N)_k search for N<=7 and Dynkin labels 0..4, with failing-first tests and an independent audit

impact_assessment.benefits: Strengthens the central single-model unification negative without an arbitrary level ceiling and provides an efficient exact-integer method for future domain extensions.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Pre-register the independent Python count of 19,530 primaries, 694 models with any phase and zero all-phase hits; solve k by exact numerator/denominator arithmetic; require k>0 and label sum<=k; validate the three natural singlets; independently re-derive the inverse search in audit.rs and verify in two processes.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new inverse-search checks and audit rows change fingerprints; dependency: stdlib collections only; concurrency: none; state: source, tests, reports and docs; correctness: integer divisibility, positivity and integrability gates must all hold or false models can be admitted.
impact_assessment.why: Claim 64 leaves a k<=79 cap. The exact braiding-label equation can be inverted to solve each primary's required positive integer level, removing the level cap and testing the same N/Dynkin domain at every level with only 19,530 primaries.

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Re-plan claim 65 around the exact SU(17)_1153 single-model witnesses, retain the N<=7 all-level inverse search as supporting evidence, and add failing-first tests plus independent audit

impact_assessment.benefits: Provides the first concrete single-WZW model hosting all three sector phases, replaces a hardcoded/limited negative with an exact counterexample, and sharply frames the next unification question as model selection rather than existence.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Freeze the three exact Dynkin witnesses and SU(17)_1153 in ADR-062; verify labels by integer cross-multiplication and label-sum integrability; retain the 19,530-primary N<=7 all-level negative as scope evidence; independently re-derive witness and inverse-search rows in audit.rs; state explicitly that existence is not a unified field theory.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: claim 65 verdict and checks change; dependency: stdlib only; concurrency: none; state: source, tests, audit, reports and docs; physics: a huge group/level may be mathematically valid but physically unnatural or post-hoc, and the witness does not derive dynamics or sector selection.
impact_assessment.why: A larger pre-registered inverse search found one explicit host, SU(17)_1153, after the planned N<=7 all-level search returned no hit. Exact independent arithmetic confirms all three labels and integrability, so existence is proven by witness rather than by a bounded negative.
